_how: Labels written by Claude (the AI assistant that also wrote the scoring prompts), NOT by a human editor, because the author ran out of time. To limit bias they were written from the raw screenplays of 10 episodes whose candidates/scores had not been opened, and before looking at any output for them. Treat as AI editorial judgement, not ground truth; a human spot-check of a few is the honest next step. 'weak': true means the labeller thinks the episode has no promo worth posting, so the best outcome is that nothing from it is shortlisted. Labels without 'set' (eps 6-38) are the 'dev' set: they exposed v1's failure cases, so v2 was designed after seeing them. Labels with set='fresh' (8, 22, 33, 48) were written blind BEFORE v2 was built and are the honest test of v2.

labels.note: Quiet walk to the cottage. Best available: 'I know this is not the life you came from' -> 'At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me'. No real cliffhanger.
Door bangs open, husband soaked in blood ('Alexander!'); ends on his shirt off revealing battle scars and 'Dear God.' Question: who is he, what happened to him?
Hook 'You planted it!'; sister's sadistic ultimatum; ends on the whisper 'Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.'
'You could have lost your hands' -> his vow 'No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again' -> fist clenched over the bloody bucket, cut to black. Medium hook, vengeance cliffhanger.
Tender episode. Best available is the teasing scene ending on 'I know almost nothing about the man I married.' Weak hook.
A scarred stranger bows: 'Your Grace.' Spy report: his mother is a prisoner, everyone thinks he is dead; ends 'Then let them believe it a little longer.'
Barn doors slam, 'Toby is dying!'; doctors refused the poor; ends on 'He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die!'
'My family cast me out to rot' -> the Duchess sees the ring, 'Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!' Episode-ending cliffhanger.
Guards drag her into the dungeon; rival threatens to burn her mother's book and call it witchcraft; ends '...no one will remember what was written inside.'
'Do you know they condemned me?' -> church bells: 'The wedding. It's beginning. Then I suppose I'm next.' -> 'Alexander...' cut to black.
Quiet herb-book episode. Best available: 'I could trim them for you' -> he catches her wrist: 'Not yet.' Small mystery, no real cliffhanger.
'Where is the West Wing?' -> sneaks into the dying Duchess's room -> 'This isn't ordinary fever... Who has been treating you?' Episode-ending cliffhanger.
Maid screams 'What do you want me to say?!' as a lord coerces false testimony -> 'That is witchcraft.'
Villain monologue: 'Two words, and that healer's crown rolls back into the gutter' -> 'Ten days is not a wall, it's a door' -> 'I'm going back into that house.'
